# asc_function (Data Source)

Fetches information about a specific function in the DSPC platform.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the function to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `concurrency` (Block List) Concurrency configuration for the function. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--concurrency))
- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the function.
- `env` (Attributes List) Environment variables for the function. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--env))
- `health_checks` (Block List) Health check configuration for the function. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--health_checks))
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the function.
- `image` (String) The container image for the function.
- `latest_ready_revision` (String) The latest ready revision of the function.
- `port` (Number) The port the container listens on.
- `resources` (Block List) Resource limits and requests for the function. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--resources))
- `secrets` (Attributes List) Runtime secrets exposed as environment variables. Only the env var names are returned; values are write-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secrets))
- `status` (String) The current status of the function.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags for the function. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `tenant_id` (String) Identifier of the tenant that owns the function.
- `updated_at` (String) The last update timestamp of the function.
- `url` (String) The URL of the function.

<a id="nestedblock--concurrency"></a>
### Nested Schema for `concurrency`

Read-Only:

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of concurrent requests.


<a id="nestedatt--env"></a>
### Nested Schema for `env`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The name of the environment variable.
- `value` (String) The value of the environment variable.


<a id="nestedblock--health_checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_checks`

Read-Only:

- `liveness` (Block List) Liveness probe configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--health_checks--liveness))
- `readiness` (Block List) Readiness probe configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--health_checks--readiness))

<a id="nestedblock--health_checks--liveness"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_checks.liveness`

Read-Only:

- `failure_threshold` (Number) Number of failures before marking as unhealthy.
- `initial_delay_seconds` (Number) Initial delay before probing starts.
- `path` (String) HTTP path for the probe.
- `period_seconds` (Number) How often to perform the probe.
- `port` (Number) Port for the probe.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Timeout for each probe attempt.
